scope: Git-tracked .mjs backend/src/4_api,5_composition,app and modules|capabilities/*/server/api or composition; source-only AST analysis, no evaluation
limitations: Nested router aliases/chained receivers not matching identified Router variables require runtime inventory
Dynamic mount loops, returned factory routers, conditional providers and middleware order require real installed-app boot
Literal local router paths are not resolved external URLs until all mount prefixes are connected
No product modules evaluated; static parser only
ServerRequestHandler URL-based liveness checks are separately recorded; not Router method declarations
Implicit HEAD, aliases, dynamic router variables, non-mjs sources, websocket upgrades and factory-returned routers are not a complete outward-surface census
Identical declaration counts do not establish path or behavior parity
Handler lexical call markers are possible risk evidence; delegated service IO remains unknown
